standard: No known unresolved blocking defects; reproducible builds; reviewed safety-critical changes; evidence for failure recovery and supported operating conditions. Passing unit tests alone is insufficient.

gates.criterion: Claude independently reviews the final code SHA, answers every G009/G010 blocking finding, and integrates only accepted changes after all supported CI jobs pass.

Supervised actual IB paper acceptance: late/partial fills, cancel/fill races, unknown intents, smoke crash cleanup, restart, margin and dedicated/allocation cash semantics. Demonstrate reservations under execution costs and gaps, and durable bounded trade-ID storage.

Prospectively specify and run adequately powered false-positive and power studies across correlated/staggered data, horizons, selection policies and failure/retry exposure. No statistical threshold relaxation. Prior bounded one-stock pilot is insufficient.

Qualify source revisions, point-in-time membership, delisting/corporate-action economics, supported calendar/adapter timestamps, true borrow/recall economics and intrabar execution. Sparse replay with whole-bar delay rounding is an approximation.

Specify and qualify adaptive strategy-bank eligibility, retirement, fallback, regime changes, and manual/supervised authority and expiry. Continuous walk-forward execution alone is not that complete product.

Pin and record runtime image and OS package provenance; qualify supervisor recovery, disk-full/power-loss behavior, migration, rotation, alert outage/delivery and resource growth during soak tests. Python dependency locks are necessary but insufficient.
Independent review of generated-code isolation and deployment permissions, resource exhaustion, supported native architectures and syscall boundaries. Existing exploit regressions remain mandatory.
